ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominating the central and lower regions, contrasted against 35% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on the distal lobe tips and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal tips exhibit large contiguous high-intensity zones. The left lobe tip features a series of parallel vertical low-intensity striations. The superior margin shows an alternating high-frequency pattern of black and white pixel clusters. The central area is a monolithic low-intensity field containing sparse circular high-intensity spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 120 degrees; depth is minimal relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing edge. The contour is non-linear, consisting of jagged, irregular peaks and deep valleys clearly delineated from the marine background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the distal margins of both lobes, exhibiting an upward and outward sweep from the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly 12-15 circular high-contrast white pixel clusters in the mid-left region of the dark central field, consistent with localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal and diagonal white linear streaks visible in the lower-left quadrant of the fluke, cutting through the low-intensity pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake-like linear abrasions on the lower left side and a distinctive brownish-orange focal anomaly located on the far right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical 'barred' pigmentation pattern on the white background of the left distal lobe tip, resembling piano keys.
